import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileNotFoundException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.*;

public class AlphaFilesShareTest {
 private static final class JSArray {
  final List<String> values;
  JSArray(List<String> values){this.values=values;}
  int length(){return values.size();}
  String optString(int index,String fallback){return values.get(index);}
 }
 private static final class PluginCall {
  final List<String> paths;
  JSObject result;
  PluginCall(List<String> paths){this.paths=paths;}
  JSArray getArray(String key){return new JSArray(paths);}
 }
 private static final class JSObject {
  final String status,message;
  int count;
  JSObject(String status,String message){this.status=status;this.message=message;}
  void put(String key,int value){if(!"count".equals(key))throw new AssertionError(key);count=value;}
 }
 private static final class StorageBrowser {
  final Path root;
  StorageBrowser(Path root){this.root=root;}
  File resolve(String path,boolean allowRoot){return root.resolve(path).toFile();}
  static String mime(String name){return "text/plain";}
 }
 private static final class Uri {}
 private static final class Intent {
  static final String ACTION_SEND="send",ACTION_SEND_MULTIPLE="multiple",EXTRA_STREAM="stream";
  static final int FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION=1;
  final String action;
  ClipData clip;
  int streams;
  Intent(String action){this.action=action;}
  Intent setType(String type){return this;}
  Intent addFlags(int flags){return this;}
  void putExtra(String key,Uri uri){streams=1;}
  void putParcelableArrayListExtra(String key,ArrayList<Uri> uris){streams=uris.size();}
  void setClipData(ClipData clip){this.clip=clip;}
  static Intent createChooser(Intent send,String label){return send;}
 }
 private static final class ClipData {
  private static final class Item {Item(Uri uri){}}
  int count=1;
  static ClipData newRawUri(String label,Uri uri){return new ClipData();}
  void addItem(Item item){count++;}
 }
 private final StorageBrowser browser;
 private int grants,choosers;
 AlphaFilesShareTest(Path root){browser=new StorageBrowser(root);}
 private static JSObject result(String status,String message){return new JSObject(status,message);}
 private interface StorageWork {JSObject run(StorageBrowser browser)throws Exception;}
 private void storage(PluginCall call,StorageWork work){
  try{call.result=work.run(browser);}
  catch(IllegalArgumentException invalid){call.result=result("invalid","Invalid name or path.");}
  catch(FileNotFoundException missing){call.result=result("missing","This item is no longer there.");}
  catch(Exception error){throw new AssertionError(error);}
 }
 private Uri contentUri(File file){grants++;return new Uri();}
 private boolean startOnUi(Intent intent){
  choosers++;
  if(intent.clip==null||intent.clip.count!=grants||intent.streams!=grants||!(grants==1?Intent.ACTION_SEND:Intent.ACTION_SEND_MULTIPLE).equals(intent.action))
   throw new AssertionError("Share must name the exact admitted selection");
  return true;
 }
 /* production strings */
 /* production share */

 public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{
  Path root=Files.createTempDirectory("alpha-share-files-");
  try {
   List<String> paths=new ArrayList<>();
   int count="101 files".equals(args[0])?101:"100 files".equals(args[0])?100:1;
   for(int i=0;i<count;i++){String name="item-"+i+".txt";Files.writeString(root.resolve(name),"fixture");paths.add(name);}
   if("mixed directory".equals(args[0])){Files.createDirectory(root.resolve("folder"));paths.add("folder");}
   if("missing file".equals(args[0]))paths.add("missing.txt");
   if("duplicate file".equals(args[0]))paths.add(paths.get(0));
   AlphaFilesShareTest fixture=new AlphaFilesShareTest(root);
   PluginCall call=new PluginCall(paths);
   fixture.storageShare(call);
   JSObject result=call.result;
   System.out.println(result.status+"|"+result.message+"|"+fixture.grants+"|"+fixture.choosers+"|"+result.count);
  } finally {
   try(java.util.stream.Stream<Path> entries=Files.walk(root)){
    for(Path entry:entries.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).toArray(Path[]::new))Files.delete(entry);
   }
  }
 }
}
